mandates.thresholdNote: All other VAT taxpayers from 2026-04-01, except the smallest taxpayers below. Previously delayed from an earlier planned 2024 date.

mandates.thresholdNote: The smallest taxpayers join from 2027-01-01 (the exact size criterion is not recorded here).
